h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & !h1_1@j | !is_bos@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j & h1_1@j, h1_1@j | !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j)
accept = is_sym0 & !is_sym1 & h1_1 & !h2_1 | is_bos & is_sym0 & !is_sym1 & h1_1 & !h2_1

output accept
